summary.text: Steve Crowell is a Republican member of the Arkansas Senate for District 3.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Senate service beginning in 2023.
According to the Senate biography, Crowell was elected in November 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023, and previously served on the Magnolia City Council.
The biography says Crowell is the owner and manager of SL Crowell Properties.

sources.title: Senator Steve Crowell (R) - Arkansas State Legislature
